title: MCP Servers
description: The three backend MCP/resource servers: oauth-mcp (banking), demo_mcp_resource_server (invest/airlines/6 other verticals), demo_api_resource_server (mortgage). Sit behind BOTH gateways — Agent Gateway (demo_mcp_gateway) and PingGateway can each route here, depending on the demo flow. PingGateway answers some tool calls itself without ever forwarding (its own synthetic 'direct response' for certain verticals) — an empty panel here can mean that, not a gap; check the P1AZ Decisions dashboard's logs to see which path a given call actually took.

options.content: Each service wraps its own single message-dispatch chokepoint (the one function every request or WebSocket message already passes through) with a Prometheus histogram — it observes what already happens, it does not change how a request is handled. Metric prefixes: `oauthmcp_` (banking MCP server), `mcprs_` (invest/airlines resource server), `apirs_` (mortgage resource server). oauth-mcp has TWO separate dispatch paths that never call each other — WebSocket (`processMessage`) and Streamable HTTP/legacy SSE (`HttpMCPTransport.handleRequest`) — each with its own panel below. Process metrics come from prom-client's default collector on each. The Logs panel is Tier 2 — Grafana Alloy tailing every container's stdout into Loki.

panels.title: Banking MCP server (oauth-mcp) — WebSocket messages by method (per 5 min)
panels.description: DemoMCPServer.processMessage — the WebSocket listener ONLY. PingGateway's OLB token exchange uses the separate HTTP transport instead (see the panel to the right) — a live demo exercised through PingGateway shows nothing here, by design, not a gap.

panels.title: Banking MCP server (oauth-mcp) — HTTP transport calls by path (per 5 min)
panels.description: HttpMCPTransport.handleRequest — Streamable HTTP + legacy SSE. This is the path PingGateway's OLB token exchange actually uses (confirmed via ping-gateway logs: 'Sending MCP initialize to http://mcp-server:8080/mcp'). Labeled by pathname, not JSON-RPC method — the method lives in the POST body, which the wrapped function reads as a stream.

panels.title: Invest/airlines resource server — messages by method (per 5 min)
panels.description: demo_mcp_resource_server/src/index.ts handleMessage — shared by the WebSocket listener and the HTTP MCP transport. Empty for tool calls PingGateway answers itself without forwarding (confirmed for sporting-goods list_gear/extend_rental via ping-gateway logs: '[OlbExchange] MCP direct response') — that's the gateway's own mock responder, not a gap here.

panels.title: Mortgage resource server (api-resource-server) — requests by route (per 5 min)
panels.description: Plain Express middleware — every HTTP request, labeled by matched route and status code.
